Equation, Quaestor and FinnOne systems

Led the end-to-end technology integration of Dubai Bank into Emirates Islamic Bank following

the strategic acquisition, providing leadership across migration planning, execution, cutover

and post-implementation stabilization. Collaborated closely with business, technology,

operations and vendor teams to ensure seamless migration of Core Banking, Lending and

Wealth Management platforms while maintaining business continuity and minimizing

operational risk

Directed large-scale digital transformation and Core banking modernization programs

across Europe, Middle East, APAC and India, delivering complex multi-country banking

implementations

Account Growth and Stakeholder Management: Managed C-suite and executive-level

stakeholder relationships across Investment banking, Retail banking and Corporate banking

divisions, driving organic account growth of 20% YoY through consistent delivery excellence

Mobile No: +91-9840326320 contactannamalai123@gmail.com

Led strategic delivery of enterprise banking transformation programs encompassing Core

Banking, Cards, Digital Banking, product modernization, platform upgrades, new product

account mining, contributing to account expansion and strategic client engagements

Led geographically distributed delivery organizations across Europe, Middle East, APAC

and India, successfully managing culturally diverse teams and globally distributed

transformation programs

Directed the technology delivery for the successful integration of two leading UAE banks,

accelerating post-merger transformation and enabling operational cost savings of USD 5M

through seamless execution and governance

Partnered with CXO and senior business stakeholders to define technology roadmaps,

align transformation initiatives with business objectives and strengthen long-term client

relationships

Championed innovation and operational excellence by implementing automation and

process optimization initiatives, including solutions that reduced manual operations by over

220 hours per month while improving efficiency and customer experience

Operational Excellence: Championed the adoption of GenAI-driven code generation and

automated testing frameworks, boosting overall engineering delivery velocity by 25%

Led and mentored cross-functional global delivery teams of 120+ professionals, fostering

a high-performance culture through coaching, talent development, succession planning and

collaborative leadership

Established robust delivery governance frameworks by leading executive steering

committees, risk management, financial governance, resource planning and quality assurance,

eventually leading to high-quality program delivery
